meta..write: auth != null && auth.uid === 'PASTE_TEACHER_UID_HERE' && (data.exists() ? data.child('ownerUid').val() === auth.uid : newData.child('ownerUid').val() === auth.uid)
meta..validate: newData.hasChildren(['ownerUid','prompt','status','createdAt']) && newData.child('ownerUid').isString() && newData.child('ownerUid').val() === auth.uid && newData.child('prompt').isString() && newData.child('prompt').val().length > 0 && newData.child('prompt').val().length <= 150 && (newData.child('status').val() === 'open' || newData.child('status').val() === 'closed') && newData.child('createdAt').isNumber()

$uid..validate: newData.hasChildren(['uid','text','createdAt','hidden']) && newData.child('uid').val() === $uid && newData.child('text').isString() && newData.child('text').val().length > 0 && newData.child('text').val().length <= 180 && newData.child('hidden').isBoolean() && newData.child('createdAt').isNumber()
